author: Adobe Creative Cloud
description: Your feedback isn’t just important to us; it directly shapes which product updates we focus on delivering. That’s why we introduced Dynamic Text in Photoshop earlier this year based on feedback from our community of customers. Now you have more precision and control when you want to intuitively place, space, and structure text layers in your Photoshop projects. What updates do you want to see next?
title: Text layers in Photoshop automatically adjust to your changes thanks to your input! Ta da! #shorts
